第三个学期上yhf的课，依旧将复健作为一个学期的开始。自入校以来的几乎每一天，每.zh: 第三个学期上yhf的课，依旧将复健作为一个学期的开始。自入校以来的几乎每一天，每日选做都始终在Chrome的待办区，大部分时候打开电脑也都有一个或好几个尚未完成的题目窗口。有时思考缓慢，有时急于求成，也不总是在此取得满意的成绩，但总会痴迷于学习一个新的算法，每一次AC弹出时都万分欣喜。总觉得作为一个ai专业的学生我还不够合格，就算vibe其他工作也要古法手搓每一道算法题，也更偏爱算法课程——上了大学依旧像一个oier。当然，作为一个oier，曾经的我更是不够合格。不过以前的事情倒也不再重要，做点虽然很累，但是有用，并且开心的事情，也挺好的。于是享受这一刻——独自一人，随时随地打开电脑，就是一个完整的世界。
第三个学期上yhf的课，依旧将复健作为一个学期的开始。自入校以来的几乎每一天，每.en: It is my third semester taking YHF's classes, and once again I am starting the semester by brushing up on my skills. Almost every day since arriving at university, the daily optional problems have stayed on my Chrome to-do list. Most times I open my laptop, one or more unfinished problems are waiting in their tabs. Sometimes I think slowly; sometimes I am too eager for results. I do not always do as well as I would like, but learning a new algorithm still draws me in, and every Accepted verdict makes me genuinely happy. I often feel I am not yet good enough as an AI student. Even if I use vibe coding for other work, I insist on solving every algorithm problem by hand, and I still prefer algorithm courses—an OI contestant at heart, even in college. Of course, I used to feel even less adequate as an OI contestant. But the past matters less now. Doing something tiring yet useful and enjoyable is a good way to spend my time. So I try to enjoy this moment: alone, anywhere, opening my laptop onto a whole world.
